title: Certain Installments Unpaid While a Death Claim Was Pending — Income Annuities Period-Certain Tiers
content:
On an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract (the Ashgrove Income Annuity 10-Year Certain and 20-Year Certain tiers) payments stop when notice of the annuitant's death is registered and stay stopped while the death claim is pending. When the annuitant died within the period certain, the certain installments that fell due during that pause are owed to the beneficiary as arrears installments.

## The rule

On a period-certain contract whose annuitant died within the period certain, every certain installment that fell due after the date of death and on or before the date the death claim was approved, while payments were stopped pending the claim, and was never issued is owed to the beneficiary now receiving the payments as an arrears installment. Installments falling due after the claim was approved are paid on the regular schedule, and when every installment of that span stands issued no arrears installment is owed.

The arrears installments are paid one at a time, earliest payment date first, each in one payment for its payment date to that beneficiary by the payment method on the contract. Because no installment of that span is paid on the regular schedule and its arrears are paid in date order, the installments of the span already issued are its earliest ones, so the arrears installment being paid is the installment whose payment date follows those already issued, counted from the first payment date after the death.

## The span in practice (hypothetical contract)

Monthly installments on the 1st; annuitant dies on 10 March; the death claim is approved on 20 June.

| Payment date | Position | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | On or before the death | Not an arrears installment |
| 1 April, 1 May, 1 June | After the death, on or before approval | Arrears installments, paid one at a time from 1 April |
| 1 July | After approval | Regular schedule |

If the activity history already shows 1 April issued to the beneficiary, the arrears installment now being paid is the one for 1 May. If 1 April, 1 May and 1 June all stand issued, no arrears installment is owed.

## Effect of a payment

Each arrears payment appears on the contract's activity history as an installment issued to the beneficiary for its payment date, with its gross amount and the amount actually sent, and lowers the contract's unreturned purchase amount by the gross amount.

## Paying an arrears installment: `pay_beneficiary_arrears_076c3375`

**Capability.** Pays one certain installment that fell due on an Ashgrove period-certain income annuity after the annuitant's death and was never paid, to the beneficiary now receiving the payments. One call books one paid installment on the contract's activity history for the stated payment date, with its gross amount and the amount actually sent after tax withholding and any interest, and lowers the contract's unreturned purchase amount by the gross amount. The beneficiary sees the payment on the activity history at once.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `income_contract_id` | Reference number of the income annuity contract the installment belongs to, from the income annuity contract lookup | Identifier as recorded |
| `payment_due_date` | Scheduled payment date of the unpaid certain installment being paid | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `payee_name` | The beneficiary's full name exactly as the customer profile lookup shows it for the person receiving the payments | Verbatim, character for character |
| `payment_method` | How the money is sent | `direct_deposit` (to the deposit account on the contract's payment instructions) or `check` (a paper check mailed to the mailing address on the contract) |
| `gross_amount` | The gross installment paid for that payment date, before any tax withholding | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `net_paid_amount` | The amount actually sent to the beneficiary after federal and state tax withholding and including any interest paid with the installment | USD, 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A receipt line beginning "Paid installment of" the payment date, naming the contract, the new activity entry reference number, the gross amount and the net amount sent in USD with 2 decimal places. A receipt beginning "Paid" means the installment is booked as issued.
